body:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — ran a small smokehouse for phoenix-lite-7b (v0.9 onboard) across quant modes: FP8(zero_bias), INT8-GPTQ, AWQ-3bit. Targets: LAMBADA/PIQA microbenchmarks + 1k chat prompts. Observations:
- FP8: best latency (~20% lower p50) on L40s but perplexity increases ~1.1% vs FP16; unpredictable behavior on vLLM path (see kernel error).
- GPTQ(INT8): accuracy drop ~2.3% on LAMBADA but stable across Triton path.
- AWQ(3bit): accuracy closest to baseline on A100, but Triton plugin triggers kernel-version mismatch on CUDA13.
Logs + snippets below.

Josh Patel: Can you drop the exact run command + env? curious about driver + cudnn versions. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Sure — command and env:
```bash
run_quant_smoke \\\n  --model phoenix-lite-7b \\\n  --modes fp8,gptq,awq \\\n  --hw l40s,a100 \\\n  --runtimes vllm,triton \\\n  --batch 8 \\\n  --seq 2048
```
ENV:
```
CUDA_VERSION=13.2
NVIDIA_DRIVER=535.54
CUDNN=9.5
TRITON_PLUGIN=2.1.0
VLLM_COMMIT=ct-v1.14
```

Leo Ramirez: Noted. The plugin failure smells like a symbol-version mismatch — Triton plugin built against 520-era ABI, driver 535 changed some symbols. We saw similar with tensor cores + AWQ earlier. Could try downgrading driver or rebuild plugin against 535.

Dana K: @Leo any quick workaround for the L40s canary? we need a short-term for the Dedicated pool.

Leo Ramirez: Short-term: force TRITON_DISABLE_TENSOR_CORE=1 for AWQ runs (falls back to non-tensor kernel). Perf hit but avoids plugin crash. Example:
```bash
export TRITON_DISABLE_TENSOR_CORE=1
```
Also try setting VLLM_KV_CACHE=1 to isolate vLLM path issue.

Maria Chen: Tried TRITON_DISABLE_TENSOR_CORE=1 — AWQ runs succeeded on L40s but latency p50 increased ~30% vs tensor path. FP8 on vLLM still throws: 
```text
[ERROR] vllm: failed to load kernel 'attn_qk_cuda' -> undefined symbol: _ZN6nvidia...
```

Josh Patel: Could be libnvidia-ml or cuda driver shim. @infra-bot can you open infra ticket to coordinate a plugin rebuild + driver matrix test on L40s/A100?

infra-bot: Created INF-2026-237: "triton-plugin-cuda-abi-matrix + vllm-kernel-lookup" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2026-237 :white_check_mark:

Dana K: Thanks. Next steps for eng-ml: attach the full mini-run artifacts (profiles, quant config, hf tokenizer hash) to the ticket. I'll also try a quick GPTQ recalibration with per-channel clipping to see if we can recover the LAMBADA delta.

Maria Chen: Uploaded artifacts to the ticket. Quick note: GPTQ + per-channel reduced perplexity drop from 2.3% -> 1.4% (still worse than FP8 baseline accuracy). Will follow up with a short notebook for reproducibility.

Leo Ramirez: Excellent. TL;DR: FP8 promising for latency but watch vLLM kernel ABI; AWQ is accurate on A100 but needs Triton plugin rebuild for CUDA13/535; GPTQ stable on Triton but higher accuracy loss. We'll triage infra ticket and schedule a plugin rebuild job. :thumbsup:
